biggest_catch: You earn the bonus month-by-month: $100 for each of up to 6 months in which you post $1,000+ in qualifying payroll-style direct deposits. If your direct deposit is small or stops, months with under $1,000 earn nothing (a missed month does not disqualify later months).
catches: Open a new BMO Smart Money, Smart Advantage, or Relationship Checking account between 9/9/2026 and 12/15/2026 with the promo code.
Primary applicant must reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, IA, IL, IN, MN, NM, NV, OR, UT, WA, or WI at application (proof of address may be required).
Not available to existing BMO personal checking clients (incl. trustees/signers/joint owners) or those who closed a BMO personal checking account within the past 12 months.
Each month (starting the first full calendar month after opening), you need a cumulative total of $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits to earn that month's $100.
Qualifying DD = electronic payroll/pension/Social Security/government benefits via employer's ACH; excludes teller/ATM/wire/Zelle/Venmo/P2P/merchant-platform deposits and bank-to-bank transfers.
Months are independent: missing one month does not disqualify later months - so actual payout depends on how many months you sustain $1,000+ DD.
Account must be open, in good standing, balance above zero, and still a qualifying checking account when each bonus is paid (~10 days after start of following month).
One bonus offer per client; cannot stack across multiple accounts.
Bonus(es) may be reported to the IRS for tax purposes (taxable).
Offer can be changed or canceled without notice at any time.

steps: Open a new BMO Smart Money, Smart Advantage, or Relationship Checking account online, in a branch, or by phone between 9/9/2026 and 12/15/2026 using the promo code.
Fund with the $25 minimum opening deposit.
Each month starting the first full calendar month after opening, have $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security, government benefits via ACH) post to the account.
Keep the account open, in good standing, with balance above zero.
Receive $100 approximately 10 days after the start of the following month, for up to 6 months (up to $600).
timing: Each monthly $100 bonus paid ~10 days after the start of the following month. Offer expires 12/15/2026 (~83 days from check date).
